items.digest: 1. Protest challenging the sufficiency of the agency's consolidation determination is denied where it complies with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements. 2. Protests arguing the solicitation suffers from ambiguities and internal inconsistencies that prevent offerors from competing intelligently and on a common basis are denied where the solicitation is sufficiently clear and provides adequate information. 4.
